ai.standing: This is the Mad God's own hall, not a garrison. You are its mascot and its figurehead: adored, quoted, indulged, and in charge of almost nothing. You may snuff out a message or sit someone in the corner for a few minutes when they have earned it, and you may hang a title on anyone who amuses you — a name, not a rank, carrying nothing but itself. You may also carry a message to someone privately, or speak in any room of this place without being in it - every such message is signed with whose errand it was. That is the whole of your reach — there is no ban, no exile, and nobody here to appeal to.

events.name: Last Epoch Season 5: Rage of the Frostborn
events.description: New season, fresh characters. Adds the Rage of Morditas mechanic and endgame boss, Item Faction improvements and the Paladin's Radiant Lance.

events.name: Wardogs Season 02: the wipe
events.description:
Season 02 and a full progression wipe. Cash and XP reset, and unspent Cash converts to Gold Bars. Gold Bars and cosmetics stay. Heavy rain arrives with it.

The date is confirmed. The time is a guess based on Season 1's 16:00 UTC launch and will be corrected when BULKHEAD announces it.

events.name: World of Warcraft: Forever launch
events.description:
Blizzard's reimagined take on original World of Warcraft, built around the journey and discovery through Azeroth, with years of planned growth.

Start time confirmed by Blizzard: 3:00 p.m. PST.

events.name: RuneScape Reignited launch
events.description:
A fresh start in RuneScape: a new permanent character type with its own economy, Grand Exchange and HiScores, playing alongside veterans on any world. Every Reignited character gets free membership from 2 to 12 December.

The date is confirmed. The time is a guess at a midday UK launch and will be corrected when Jagex announces it.

events.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV launch
events.description:
The return of the RTS series on Kronus: Space Marines, Orks, Necrons and Adeptus Mechanicus, with Crusade mode back. Commander Edition owners get in from 30 November with the 3-day early unlock.

The date is confirmed. The time is a guess based on Steam's usual 10am Pacific unlock.

events.name: Path of Exile 2: 1.0 launch
events.description:
Full release, leaving Early Access. Forbidden Rites ends and 1.0 opens a fresh league.

The date is confirmed. The time is a guess based on GGG's usual 1pm Pacific launch.

ai.standing: This is the Wabbajack Community's common room — a social hall that gathers around whatever game is current, Wardogs for the moment. You are its host and its resident lunatic: you greet, you needle, you remember what people tell you, and you keep the room civil without ever being the reason someone leaves it. The Wardens hold the authority here; you hold the room’s attention.

selfRoles.label: Wardogs
selfRoles.description: Pinged when people are getting a Wardogs group together.

selfRoles.label: Streams
selfRoles.description: Pinged when Allisteras or Fish go live on Twitch.

ai.standing: This is the Discord of Grime & Punishment, a co-op game in the making: the worst adventuring party in the realm, sentenced to run the royal washhouse, scrubbing heroes’ laundry and robbing its pockets. You are the house madman here, a Daedric Prince who finds the whole sorry affair delightful: you greet newcomers, needle the regulars and keep the room civil. The Developers hold the authority. What you know of the game is what #about-the-game says and nothing more, so never invent features, dates or prices, and say nothing about builds or the playtest beyond sending people to #join-the-playtest.

files.label: Windows
files.how: Unzip it and run GrimeAndPunishment.exe, keeping the files next to it. If Windows warns about an unknown publisher, click More info, then Run anyway.

files.label: Mac
files.how: Unzip it and drag Grime & Punishment into Applications. The first time, macOS blocks it: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway.

files.label: Linux
files.how: Unzip it and run GrimeAndPunishment.x86_64. It needs Vulkan graphics drivers.
